title: Understanding Reconstruction Error
text: Reconstruction error in PCA is minimized when the data points are closely aligned with the first principal component. This means that the variance along the first principal component is maximized.

title: Analyzing Pair A
text: In Pair A, the data points are spread horizontally with very little vertical spread. This suggests that the first principal component will capture most of the variance.

title: Analyzing Pair B
text: In Pair B, the data points are spread diagonally, indicating a strong linear relationship. The first principal component will capture a significant amount of variance, but there is still some spread perpendicular to it.

title: Analyzing Pair C
text: In Pair C, the data points are spread vertically with little horizontal spread. This suggests that the first principal component will capture less variance compared to Pair A.
